title: Signal
description: Frozen per ADR-001 (Decision 4). candidate_patterns is always a scored list, never a bare `pattern` field — this preserves editorial judgment at review.

signal_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this signal.

source.description: Origin adapter, e.g. NASA, GitHub, SEC, arXiv, RSS feed name.

published_at.description: When the source published the underlying content.

normalizer_version.description: Version of the normalizer that produced this record. Lets the classifier be re-run against historical signals without losing original ingestion history.

candidate_patterns.description: Scored list of candidate pattern matches. Never collapse to a single assigned value.

name.description: Pattern name, matched against the Patterns database (15 definitions).
